findings.title: Placement adapter no longer implements level-elevation contract
findings.body: The unstaged change removes GetLevelElevationFor from RevitFoundationPlacementAdapter even though the adapter implements IFoundationPlacementAdapter and foundation placement needs this mapping. If the interface still declares the member, the exact snapshot cannot compile. If the interface was changed elsewhere, that change is outside the included scope and the orchestrator can no longer normalize each CAD Z coordinate to a project level before placement. Restore the adapter method and verify the interface/orchestrator contract.

findings.title: New CAD extraction behavior has no focused test coverage
findings.body: ExtractFromSegments introduces substantial geometry behavior—face extraction, rectangle tolerances, dimension filtering, rotation, and deduplication—but the evidence contains no focused tests. Regressions involving rotated rectangles, fragmented line loops, duplicate faces, elevation grouping, and tolerance boundaries could silently create missing or duplicate foundations. This does not satisfy the plan's requirement for tests proportional to risk.

findings.title: CAD extraction is not connected to foundation placement
findings.body: The new orchestrator only accepts an already-created IEnumerable<FoundationData>; none of the included implementation invokes CadParserService.ExtractFromSegments or otherwise connects CAD input to PlaceFoundations. The added tests stop after validating extraction and never invoke the orchestrator or assert any adapter placement call. Consequently, the reviewed changes do not implement or demonstrate the required end-to-end behavior of automatically placing foundations from CAD.

findings.title: New placement behavior has no focused tests
findings.body: All four tests exercise only existing parser output. There is no coverage for adapter invocation, invalid dimensions or non-finite values, type-creation failure, rotation forwarding, or the number of foundations placed. A regression in which FoundationPlacementOrchestrator never calls PlaceFoundation would leave this test suite passing.
